verdicts.reason: Both lose the hero photo of the clasped hands, which is the core of the design. The quote shrinks to a tiny centered block on a mostly empty white strip, and the 'MAHATMA GANDHI' credit is too small to read and jammed under the last line. A leaves only stray cloud and scribble fragments at its edges. B adds a meaningless black rectangle above the headline, a leftover sliver of the photo, which makes it slightly worse.
